facts.business: Sky Gold and Diamonds Limited is a B2B gold jewellery manufacturer focused on lightweight, value-added jewellery (9K, 18K, diamond-studded) and an asset-light model with advance gold business, serving Indian retail chains and expanding exports via a Dubai office.

guidance_or_targets.statement: A stated roadmap to be net debt-free by FY2029-30

auditor.name: M S K A & Associates LLP (formerly M S K A & Associates)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Auditor's Report for the financial year under review does not contain any qualification, reservation, or adverse remark.

key_risks: Employee skill development and workplace safety
Competitive intensity in organised jewellery manufacturing
facts.related_party_note: Sales to related parties were 4.7% of total sales in FY2025-26 (Nil in FY2024-25). Investments in related parties were 91% of total investments in FY2025-26 (81% in FY2024-25). Purchases, loans & advances with related parties were Nil in both years.
